text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at that poster!
It says, 'The Magician of the Floor arrives the day after tomorrow!'
choice_data_list: Hmm, this feels a bit different from the mage I had in mind...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"You can't know that unless you check it out!
I want to see the magician! I'm going, and that's final!!"

Considering our previous tour of underwhelming magical spots,
this one looks like it'll turn out to be another disappointing result far removed from actual magic, but—
choice_data_list: ...All right, let's go check it out!

text_block_list.text:
"If it's what Sweep Tosho wishes for,
even if it's far removed from magic,
I want to guide her well and make sure she has fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's so lively!
Everyone making such a dizzying racket...
...So this is the witches' coven I've heard rumors about!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Besides, the magician's appearance... both time and place are a secret! A true magician's surprise! I'll definitely find him!

A magician said to be making a surprise appearance
on one of the stages in the venue. In that case,
it would be best to find a spot with a view of the whole area.
choice_data_list: Let's move to the center stage—

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! A surprise guerrilla gig at the venue entrance!
The up-and-coming singer, Adam, has arrived~~!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Where are you going?! You'll regret missing this!
Let's dash to the entrance together!
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, where are you going!?
I'm heading to the center stage ahead of you, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You didn't come for Adam, but to see that magician?!
My bad, my bad! I'll give you some solid info to make up for it...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Finally here!
Honestly, quite the nerve making your master wait!
choice_data_list: I've got intel on the magician!
I've got intel on the magician!

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah!! Blast that volume to the max~~!!
—This is the best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat?!
I can't hear youuu?!
choice_data_list: A-Anyway, come over here!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a magician here...
There are definitely staff-looking people scurrying around!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*cough cough*... Hmm,
is it because I shouted earlier?
I hope I can speak properly with the wizard.
choice_data_list: I'll go buy some drinks!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Delicious♪ Familiar, you did quite a fine job!
Now all we need is for the Magician to arrive, and it'll be perfect!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
This is where that magician is coming, right?!
Let's get closer to the front! —Wait, whoa?!
(Thud! Splash...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Limited-edition drink!
My favorite socks~~~!!
choice_data_list: L-Let's hurry and wash it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! The magician's stage ended while I was washing up?!

...In the end, I failed again.
Of all things, I ended up ruining the very event Sweep Tosho was hoping for...
choice_data_list: ...Sorry, I keep messing up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, you're hopeless.
Trip up once and you just keep stumbling.
Moping around like that—
choice_data_list: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: To think you consider something like this a failure!
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got it? You're basically just an apprentice
who just became a familiar! Understand?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
She's not a genius magical girl like me, you know!
Of course she can't do it perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Even someone like me used to be... in the past.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*cough, cough*!
Ugh, why did the pot explode...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
You really took a nasty spill! But don't worry.
As long as you're not hurt, that's good enough for now.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's not fine at all! I ruined the ingredients,
and I even... burned the pot...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Now that Sweepy knows the pot can explode,
she'll be more careful next time, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
That's how everyone improves.
What you just piled up isn't failure. It's the stepping stone to success!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"So, there's no reason to be down!
We're just gonna keep racking 'em up from here on out!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma taught me that there's no such thing as failure in this world.
I believe that too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're the exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You seemed a bit overwhelmed by all the info on our last magic spot tour...
But because of that, you did so much research this time around!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it seems you couldn't quite find your footing at an unfamiliar magical gathering?
Even so, you can just use that experience next time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
With all the hard work you've put in, you've definitely
been climbing the ranks as a familiar, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So keep devoting yourself without cutting corners!
You are my familiar, after all!!
choice_data_list: I'm glad, thank you.
You were watching how hard I worked, huh.
You were watching how hard I worked, weren't you?
I'll aim to become the ultimate familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So keep devoting yourself without cutting corners!
You are my familiar, after all!!
choice_data_list: I'm glad, thank you.
You were watching how hard I worked, huh.
You were watching how hard I worked, weren't you?
I'll aim to become the ultimate familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's too early to celebrate!
I'm not satisfied yet, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I'm getting hungry,
so first, bring me something sweet♪

I made a promise to Sweep Tosho,
who was smiling brightly.
I vowed to keep striving to make her happy from now on...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "It's not like I was watching closely! You were just making a racket and looking mopey, so you caught my eye, that's all!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! You're my familiar, so no more making such pathetic faces!
Next time, I'll punish you with magic!
Even if they weren't direct about it, they genuinely cared. Feeling that brought a warm comfort to the heart...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh my, it's wonderful that you're so motivated!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right! You need to become the strongest familiar, one I can brag about to all my fellow witches!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because someday, you're gonna become
the "Great Witch" Sweepy's familiar, okay?!
